ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool for agricultural land and environmental compliance, tracking soil health degradation and illegal deforestation using multi-spectral imagery.
ideas.title: AgriSustain-Satellite-Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the Agriculture & Sustainability domain and leverages the technically hard engineering pattern seen in GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition and wellness platform built specifically for regional dietary needs that delivers personalized meal recommendations and nutritional insights instantly.
ideas.title: NutriHealth-AI-Personalizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Healthcare & Wellness domain directly and replicates the winning formula of the E-Foodiee 24-hour hackathon project.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support and learning assistant platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized academic guidance for institutional course management.
ideas.title: EduAgent-Multi-Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the EdTech domain and utilizes the proven multi-agent RAG architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain risk detection and investigation platform combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning to trace agricultural subsidies and detect fraudulent fund routing.
ideas.title: AgriTrace-Graph-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the Agriculture & Sustainability domain with hard engineering graph intelligence techniques proven in the Bito AML platform.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine designed for specialized healthcare clinics to automate consultations, intake forms, and treatment visualization.
ideas.title: PatientTrust-Prosthodontic-Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Healthcare & Wellness domain using a proven rapid-sprint implementation strategy from the Global-Smile win.
